description: In front of you on the bed are a gray plastic tray with clear ice cubes, a small yellow cup to the left, and a purple scoop/holder to the right. The left hand reaches to the yellow cup, lifts it, moves it over the tray, tips and presses the cup into the ice to scoop and dump the cubes around, then lifts the cup back out and returns it toward the left side while the right hand stays resting near the purple tool without grabbing anything.
